messages:
Noor (Partnerships): Heads-up: joint Summit webinar + co-announcement with CloudHarbor & VectorSI. Need to lock: marketplace certification callout, SI preflight checklist, embargo timing, demo failovers, and international swag customs notes. Can we confirm by Thu EOD? Link to runbook: https://drive.google.com/summit-coannounce (comments only)
Mira (BizDev): I'll confirm CloudHarbor's certification badge text. Partners want the marketplace tile ready before press. Also ask partners for a 1-line product blurb + logo SVG.
Leo (Hardware): Hardware shipping: 2 devboxes + 1 rack node. Need foam cases + IEC leads + customs invoice flagged as "demo units". FreightBot, can you confirm ETA and customs docs?
FreightBot: Shipment TRK-77234: ETA Fri 06:30, customs docs uploaded to drive TRK-77234/docs. I'll request "demo unit" marking. Noted foam cases and IEC leads.
Priya (Marketing): Embargo proposal: partners sign off by Wed 11:00 PT, embargo lifts Fri 2pm PT after talk. Ok with partners? We'll prepare the joint press blurb and a marketplace blurb for Noah.
Arjun (SI): For the SI preflight clinic, request two 20-min slots after the session (max 10 each). We'll run a short template: bring a sample prompt and an architecture diagram. RSVP required.
Noor (Partnerships): Good. Also need demo fallback plan: each partner must provide (A) 60s pre-recorded clip, (B) static slide, (C) curl fallback snippet pointing to hosted API. Upload by Wed 09:00.
DevOps Bot: Will pre-warm hosted fallback endpoint in region us-west-2 starting 30m before event and run keepalives every 10m. If Dedicated fails, fallback to model=redwood-lite-quant with throttling 25rps.
Mira (BizDev): Can you paste a partner-facing curl snippet we can include?
DevOps Bot: Sure:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-lite-quant","prompt":"<your prompt>","max_tokens":80}'
```
Priya (Marketing): Swag plan: co-branded sticker packs + postcard + small promo kits. International customs: mark as "promotional materials" and include HS code. FreightBot please confirm paperwork. Limit tees to VIPs only; we'll track via RSVP.
FreightBot: Confirmed: will include HS code and commercial invoice flagged as "promotional samples". Will provide pickup window Fri 07:00-09:00.
Leo (Hardware): AV + space ask: dedicated 220V circuit for rack, 2x 6ft tables, non-slip mats, local router for isolated VLAN (hotel NAT flaky). If VLAN denied, we'll use offline demo bundle.
Noor (Partnerships): Volunteers: swag desk shifts 09:30-11:30, 11:30-14:00, 14:00-16:30. Need 2 per shift. Priya can you staff morning?
Priya (Marketing): Yes for morning. I'll publish signup and volunteer brief (QR flow + tee limits + one-sentence partner pitch).
Arjun (SI): Integrator clinic agenda: 1) quick infra checklist (5m) 2) live walkthrough (12m) 3) Q&A (3m). Will bring a small sample dataset. Need breakout room booked.
Noor (Partnerships): Final checklist: upload fallback clip + slide, add privacy line "Demo inputs are synthetic or anonymized; no customer PII is stored", add unresolved items as comments in runbook. Dry-run Thu 15:00; green room 25m prior. Thanks team :thumbsup:
